package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"path"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

const (
	TaskBlueprintSchemaV1      = "practice-task-blueprint.v1"
	AuthoringCandidateSchemaV1 = "tz-authoring-candidate.v1"
)

type TaskBlueprintV1 struct {
	Schema           string                `json:"schema"`
	Identity         BlueprintIdentity     `json:"identity"`
	Classification   Classification        `json:"classification"`
	Difficulty       Difficulty            `json:"difficulty"`
	Scenario         Scenario              `json:"scenario"`
	Acceptance       []AcceptanceCriterion `json:"acceptance"`
	Milestones       []Milestone           `json:"milestones"`
	Runtime          RuntimeSpec           `json:"runtime"`
	Evaluation       EvaluationSpec        `json:"evaluation"`
	AssistancePolicy AssistancePolicy      `json:"assistance_policy"`
	Traceability     []TraceabilityLink    `json:"traceability"`
	Source           SourceProvenance      `json:"source"`
	Generation       GenerationMetadata    `json:"generation"`
}

type BlueprintIdentity struct {
	FamilyKey  string `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey string `json:"variant_key"`
}

type Classification struct {
	TaskType              string   `json:"task_type"`
	SurfaceClassification string   `json:"surface_classification"`
	Domains               []string `json:"domains"`
	Stacks                []string `json:"stacks"`
	Topology              string   `json:"topology"`
}

type Difficulty struct {
	Implementation int    `json:"implementation"`
	Algorithms     int    `json:"algorithms"`
	Architecture   int    `json:"architecture"`
	Debugging      int    `json:"debugging"`
	Ambiguity      int    `json:"ambiguity"`
	Autonomy       int    `json:"autonomy"`
	DerivedLevel   string `json:"derived_level"`
}

type Scenario struct {
	Title        string        `json:"title"`
	Goal         string        `json:"goal"`
	Roles        []string      `json:"roles"`
	Requirements []Requirement `json:"requirements"`
	Constraints  []string      `json:"constraints"`
	NonGoals     []string      `json:"non_goals"`
}

type Requirement struct {
	ID   string `json:"id"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

type AcceptanceCriterion struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Text         string `json:"text"`
	EvidenceKind string `json:"evidence_kind"`
}

type Milestone struct {
	ID            string   `json:"id"`
	Title         string   `json:"title"`
	Objective     string   `json:"objective"`
	Dependencies  []string `json:"dependencies"`
	AcceptanceIDs []string `json:"acceptance_ids"`
	Steps         []Step   `json:"steps"`
}

type Step struct {
	ID                       string                `json:"id"`
	Title                    string                `json:"title"`
	Objective                string                `json:"objective"`
	Dependencies             []string              `json:"dependencies"`
	Deliverables             []string              `json:"deliverables"`
	AcceptanceIDs            []string              `json:"acceptance_ids"`
	LearningRequirements     []LearningRequirement `json:"learning_requirements"`
	ValidationRequirementIDs []string              `json:"validation_requirement_ids"`
	AssistancePolicyOverride *AssistancePolicy     `json:"assistance_policy_override,omitempty"`
	EstimatedEffortMinutes   int                   `json:"estimated_effort_minutes"`
}

type LearningTargetRef struct {
	Type    string `json:"type"`
	Key     string `json:"key"`
	Version string `json:"version"`
}

type LearningRequirement struct {
	ID               string            `json:"id"`
	Target           LearningTargetRef `json:"target"`
	Policy           string            `json:"policy"`
	MasteryThreshold float64           `json:"mastery_threshold"`
}

type RuntimeSpec struct {
	CodeStructureTypeCode string            `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
	ProfileRef            RuntimeProfileRef `json:"profile_ref"`
	StarterWorkspace      StarterWorkspace  `json:"starter_workspace"`
}

type RuntimeProfileRef struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Version string `json:"version"`
	Digest  string `json:"digest"`
}

type WorkspaceFixture struct {
	Files []WorkspaceFile `json:"files"`
}

type WorkspaceFile struct {
	Path     string `json:"path"`
	Content  string `json:"content"`
	ReadOnly bool   `json:"read_only,omitempty"`
}

type StarterWorkspace struct {
	Files         []WorkspaceFile `json:"files"`
	ReadOnlyFiles []string        `json:"readonly_files"`
	EditableFiles []string        `json:"editable_files"`
	Entrypoints   []string        `json:"entrypoints"`
	PreviewConfig map[string]any  `json:"preview_config"`
	Meta          map[string]any  `json:"meta"`
}

func (workspace StarterWorkspace) Fixture() WorkspaceFixture {
	return WorkspaceFixture{Files: append([]WorkspaceFile(nil), workspace.Files...)}
}

type EvaluationSpec struct {
	Validator ValidatorSpec `json:"validator"`
	Review    ReviewPolicy  `json:"review"`
}

type ValidatorSpec struct {
	Version int              `json:"version"`
	Checks  []ValidatorCheck `json:"checks"`
}

type ValidatorCheck struct {
	ID            string   `json:"id"`
	Kind          string   `json:"kind"`
	Visibility    string   `json:"visibility"`
	AcceptanceIDs []string `json:"acceptance_ids"`
}

type ReviewPolicy struct {
	Version               int          `json:"version"`
	DeterministicRequired bool         `json:"deterministic_required"`
	AI                    ReviewMode   `json:"ai"`
	Human                 ReviewMode   `json:"human"`
	Rules                 []ReviewRule `json:"rules"`
}

type ReviewMode struct {
	Mode string `json:"mode"`
}

type ReviewRule struct {
	ID            string   `json:"id"`
	AcceptanceIDs []string `json:"acceptance_ids"`
}

type AssistancePolicy struct {
	Version                     int             `json:"version"`
	MaxHintLevel                int             `json:"max_hint_level"`
	RevealSolutionAfterAttempts *int            `json:"reveal_solution_after_attempts,omitempty"`
	Teacher                     TeacherPolicy   `json:"teacher"`
	Debugging                   DebuggingPolicy `json:"debugging"`
}

type TeacherPolicy struct {
	MayExplain               bool `json:"may_explain"`
	MayWriteCompleteSolution bool `json:"may_write_complete_solution"`
}

type DebuggingPolicy struct {
	MayPointToArea     bool `json:"may_point_to_area"`
	MayNameLikelyCause bool `json:"may_name_likely_cause"`
	MaySuggestPatch    bool `json:"may_suggest_patch"`
}

type TraceabilityLink struct {
	RequirementID          string   `json:"requirement_id"`
	AcceptanceIDs          []string `json:"acceptance_ids"`
	ValidatorCheckIDs      []string `json:"validator_check_ids"`
	ReviewRuleIDs          []string `json:"review_rule_ids"`
	LearningRequirementIDs []string `json:"learning_requirement_ids"`
}

type SourceProvenance struct {
	SourceType            string `json:"source_type"`
	SourceURL             string `json:"source_url,omitempty"`
	SourceCommitSHA       string `json:"source_commit_sha,omitempty"`
	SourcePath            string `json:"source_path,omitempty"`
	SourceLocator         string `json:"source_locator,omitempty"`
	OriginalManifestHash  string `json:"original_manifest_hash"`
	Company               string `json:"company,omitempty"`
	License               string `json:"license,omitempty"`
	Anonymized            bool   `json:"anonymized"`
	EducationalAdaptation string `json:"educational_adaptation,omitempty"`
}

type GenerationMetadata struct {
	PlannerVersion          string   `json:"planner_version"`
	GenerationPolicyVersion string   `json:"generation_policy_version"`
	Method                  string   `json:"method"`
	Tone                    string   `json:"tone"`
	Methodology             string   `json:"methodology"`
	SkillRefs               []string `json:"skill_refs"`
	PromptTemplateRef       string   `json:"prompt_template_ref"`
	ModelProvider           string   `json:"model_provider"`
	ModelID                 string   `json:"model_id"`
	GenerationJobID         string   `json:"generation_job_id"`
	InputDigest             string   `json:"input_digest"`
}

// AuthoringCandidateV1 contains public blueprint semantics plus private
// executable authoring material. PrivateEvaluation is never returned from a
// public catalog/runtime endpoint.
type AuthoringCandidateV1 struct {
	Schema            string                  `json:"schema"`
	Blueprint         TaskBlueprintV1         `json:"blueprint"`
	PrivateEvaluation PrivateEvaluationBundle `json:"private_evaluation"`
}

type PrivateEvaluationBundle struct {
	CodeStructure json.RawMessage  `json:"code_structure"`
	Reference     WorkspaceFixture `json:"reference"`
	Negatives     []NamedFixture   `json:"negative_fixtures"`
}

type NamedFixture struct {
	ID        string           `json:"id"`
	Workspace WorkspaceFixture `json:"workspace"`
}

var (
	idPattern        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
	targetPattern    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]{0,254}$`)
	codeTypePattern  = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$`)
	digestPattern    = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
	promptRefPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}@[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`)
)

var supportedTaskTypes = set("BUILD", "FEATURE", "BUGFIX", "DEBUG", "REFACTOR", "TESTING", "CODE_REVIEW", "INTERVIEW", "INCIDENT", "PERFORMANCE", "MIGRATION", "ARCHITECTURE", "DATABASE", "REVERSE_ENGINEERING")
var supportedSurfaceClassifications = set(SurfaceClassificationPractice, SurfaceClassificationProject)
var supportedTopologies = set("workspace", "frontend", "backend", "fullstack", "multi_service")
var supportedLevels = set("beginner", "junior", "junior_plus", "middle", "senior")
var supportedPolicies = set("required", "recommended", "optional", "adaptive")
var supportedEvidence = set("deterministic", "ai_review", "human_review", "mixed")
var supportedCheckKinds = set("workspace", "static", "runtime", "browser_behavior", "test", "review")
var supportedAIReview = set("never", "optional", "required")
var supportedHumanReview = set("never", "on_request", "on_uncertain", "on_failure", "premium", "certification", "mandatory", "random_audit")

func DecodeCandidate(raw []byte) (AuthoringCandidateV1, error) {
	candidate, err := DecodeCandidateShape(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
		return AuthoringCandidateV1{}, err
	}
	return candidate, nil
}

func DecodeCandidateShape(raw []byte) (AuthoringCandidateV1, error) {
	var candidate AuthoringCandidateV1
	if err := decodeStrict(raw, &candidate); err != nil {
		return candidate, validationf("candidate shape: %v", err)
	}
	return candidate, nil
}

func (candidate *AuthoringCandidateV1) Validate() error {
	candidate.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(candidate.Schema)
	if candidate.Schema != AuthoringCandidateSchemaV1 {
		return validationf("candidate schema must be %q", AuthoringCandidateSchemaV1)
	}
	if err := candidate.Blueprint.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !validJSONObject(candidate.PrivateEvaluation.CodeStructure) || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(candidate.PrivateEvaluation.CodeStructure), []byte("{}")) {
		return validationf("private_evaluation.code_structure must be an object")
	}
	if err := validateStarterWorkspace(candidate.Blueprint.Runtime.StarterWorkspace); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateFixture(candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Reference, "reference", true); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Negatives) == 0 || len(candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Negatives) > 20 {
		return validationf("negative_fixtures must contain between 1 and 20 items")
	}
	negativeIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Negatives {
		fixture := &candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Negatives[index]
		fixture.ID = strings.TrimSpace(fixture.ID)
		if err := addID(negativeIDs, fixture.ID, "negative fixture"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := validateFixture(fixture.Workspace, "negative fixture "+fixture.ID, true); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (blueprint *TaskBlueprintV1) Validate() error {
	blueprint.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Schema)
	if blueprint.Schema != TaskBlueprintSchemaV1 {
		return validationf("blueprint schema must be %q", TaskBlueprintSchemaV1)
	}
	blueprint.Identity.FamilyKey = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Identity.FamilyKey)
	blueprint.Identity.VariantKey = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Identity.VariantKey)
	if !idPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Identity.FamilyKey) || !idPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Identity.VariantKey) {
		return validationf("family and variant keys must be stable identifiers")
	}
	if err := normalizeBlueprintClassification(&blueprint.Classification); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var err error
	for name, value := range map[string]int{"implementation": blueprint.Difficulty.Implementation, "algorithms": blueprint.Difficulty.Algorithms, "architecture": blueprint.Difficulty.Architecture, "debugging": blueprint.Difficulty.Debugging, "ambiguity": blueprint.Difficulty.Ambiguity, "autonomy": blueprint.Difficulty.Autonomy} {
		if value < 1 || value > 5 {
			return validationf("difficulty.%s must be 1..5", name)
		}
	}
	blueprint.Difficulty.DerivedLevel = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Difficulty.DerivedLevel))
	if _, ok := supportedLevels[blueprint.Difficulty.DerivedLevel]; !ok {
		return validationf("unsupported derived level")
	}
	blueprint.Scenario.Title, err = normalizeText(blueprint.Scenario.Title, "scenario.title")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	blueprint.Scenario.Goal, err = normalizeText(blueprint.Scenario.Goal, "scenario.goal")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	blueprint.Scenario.Roles, err = normalizeTextList(blueprint.Scenario.Roles, "scenario.roles", true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	blueprint.Scenario.Constraints, err = normalizeTextList(blueprint.Scenario.Constraints, "scenario.constraints", false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	blueprint.Scenario.NonGoals, err = normalizeTextList(blueprint.Scenario.NonGoals, "scenario.non_goals", false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(blueprint.Scenario.Requirements) == 0 {
		return validationf("scenario title, goal, and requirements are required")
	}
	requirements := map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range blueprint.Scenario.Requirements {
		item := &blueprint.Scenario.Requirements[index]
		item.ID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ID)
		if err := addID(requirements, item.ID, "requirement"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		item.Text, err = normalizeText(item.Text, "requirement text")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	acceptance := map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range blueprint.Acceptance {
		item := &blueprint.Acceptance[index]
		item.ID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ID)
		item.EvidenceKind = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.EvidenceKind))
		item.Text, err = normalizeText(item.Text, "acceptance text")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, ok := supportedEvidence[item.EvidenceKind]; !ok {
			return validationf("acceptance %q has unsupported evidence kind", item.ID)
		}
		if err := addID(acceptance, item.ID, "acceptance"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if len(acceptance) == 0 {
		return validationf("at least one acceptance criterion is required")
	}
	learning, checks, reviewRules, err := validateWorkAndEvaluation(blueprint, acceptance)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateAssistance(blueprint.AssistancePolicy); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	blueprint.Runtime.CodeStructureTypeCode = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Runtime.CodeStructureTypeCode)
	blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Code = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Code)
	blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Version = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Version)
	blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Digest = strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Digest)
	if !codeTypePattern.MatchString(blueprint.Runtime.CodeStructureTypeCode) || !idPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Code) || !idPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Version) || !digestPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Runtime.ProfileRef.Digest) {
		return validationf("runtime profile must be an exact code/version/digest")
	}
	if err := validateTraceability(blueprint.Traceability, requirements, acceptance, checks, reviewRules, learning); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := normalizeSource(&blueprint.Source); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := normalizeGeneration(&blueprint.Generation); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !digestPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Source.OriginalManifestHash) || blank(blueprint.Source.SourceType) {
		return validationf("source type and original manifest digest are required")
	}
	if blueprint.Generation.PlannerVersion == "" || blueprint.Generation.GenerationPolicyVersion == "" || blueprint.Generation.PromptTemplateRef == "" || !digestPattern.MatchString(blueprint.Generation.InputDigest) {
		return validationf("complete generation policy and input provenance are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidSurfaceClassification(value string) bool {
	_, ok := supportedSurfaceClassifications[value]
	return ok
}

func normalizeBlueprintClassification(classification *Classification) error {
	classification.TaskType = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(classification.TaskType))
	classification.SurfaceClassification = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(classification.SurfaceClassification))
	classification.Topology = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(classification.Topology))
	if _, ok := supportedTaskTypes[classification.TaskType]; !ok {
		return validationf("unsupported task type")
	}
	if !ValidSurfaceClassification(classification.SurfaceClassification) {
		return validationf("unsupported surface classification")
	}
	var err error
	classification.Domains, err = normalizeIdentifierList(classification.Domains, "classification.domains", true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	classification.Stacks, err = normalizeIdentifierList(classification.Stacks, "classification.stacks", true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := supportedTopologies[classification.Topology]; !ok {
		return validationf("classification requires supported topology, domains, and stacks")
	}
	return nil
}

func validateWorkAndEvaluation(blueprint *TaskBlueprintV1, acceptance map[string]struct{}) (map[string]struct{}, map[string]struct{}, map[string]struct{}, error) {
	if len(blueprint.Milestones) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, nil, validationf("at least one milestone is required")
	}
	milestoneIDs, stepIDs, learning := map[string]struct{}{}, map[string]struct{}{}, map[string]struct{}{}
	milestoneGraph, stepGraph := map[string][]string{}, map[string][]string{}
	assignedAcceptance, referencedChecks := map[string]struct{}{}, map[string]struct{}{}
	for milestoneIndex := range blueprint.Milestones {
		milestone := &blueprint.Milestones[milestoneIndex]
		milestone.ID = strings.TrimSpace(milestone.ID)
		var err error
		milestone.Title, err = normalizeText(milestone.Title, "milestone title")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		milestone.Objective, err = normalizeText(milestone.Objective, "milestone objective")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		if len(milestone.Steps) == 0 {
			return nil, nil, nil, validationf("milestone title, objective, and steps are required")
		}
		if err := addID(milestoneIDs, milestone.ID, "milestone"); err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		milestone.Dependencies, err = normalizeIDList(milestone.Dependencies, "milestone dependencies", false)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		milestoneGraph[milestone.ID] = milestone.Dependencies
		milestone.AcceptanceIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(milestone.AcceptanceIDs, acceptance, "milestone acceptance", true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		for stepIndex := range milestone.Steps {
			step := &milestone.Steps[stepIndex]
			step.ID = strings.TrimSpace(step.ID)
			step.Title, err = normalizeText(step.Title, "step title")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			step.Objective, err = normalizeText(step.Objective, "step objective")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			step.Deliverables, err = normalizeTextList(step.Deliverables, "step deliverables", true)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			if step.EstimatedEffortMinutes < 1 || step.EstimatedEffortMinutes > 10080 {
				return nil, nil, nil, validationf("step %q has incomplete semantics or invalid effort", step.ID)
			}
			if err := addID(stepIDs, step.ID, "step"); err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			step.Dependencies, err = normalizeIDList(step.Dependencies, "step dependencies", false)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			stepGraph[step.ID] = step.Dependencies
			step.AcceptanceIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(step.AcceptanceIDs, acceptance, "step acceptance", true)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			for _, id := range step.AcceptanceIDs {
				assignedAcceptance[id] = struct{}{}
			}
			step.ValidationRequirementIDs, err = normalizeIDList(step.ValidationRequirementIDs, "step validation requirements", false)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, nil, nil, err
			}
			for _, checkID := range step.ValidationRequirementIDs {
				referencedChecks[checkID] = struct{}{}
			}
			for learningIndex := range step.LearningRequirements {
				item := &step.LearningRequirements[learningIndex]
				item.ID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ID)
				item.Target.Key = strings.TrimSpace(item.Target.Key)
				item.Target.Version = strings.TrimSpace(item.Target.Version)
				item.Policy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Policy))
				if err := addID(learning, item.ID, "learning requirement"); err != nil {
					return nil, nil, nil, err
				}
				if item.Target.Type != "concept" && item.Target.Type != "capability" || !validLearningTargetKey(item.Target.Key) || !idPattern.MatchString(item.Target.Version) {
					return nil, nil, nil, validationf("learning requirement %q has invalid exact target", item.ID)
				}
				if _, ok := supportedPolicies[item.Policy]; !ok || item.MasteryThreshold <= 0 || item.MasteryThreshold > 1 {
					return nil, nil, nil, validationf("learning requirement %q has invalid policy", item.ID)
				}
			}
			if step.AssistancePolicyOverride != nil {
				if err := validateAssistance(*step.AssistancePolicyOverride); err != nil {
					return nil, nil, nil, err
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(learning) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, nil, validationf("at least one learning requirement is required")
	}
	if err := validateDAG(milestoneGraph, milestoneIDs, "milestone"); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	if err := validateDAG(stepGraph, stepIDs, "step"); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	for id := range acceptance {
		if _, ok := assignedAcceptance[id]; !ok {
			return nil, nil, nil, validationf("acceptance %q is not assigned to a step", id)
		}
	}
	if blueprint.Evaluation.Validator.Version != 1 || blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Version != 2 || !blueprint.Evaluation.Review.DeterministicRequired {
		return nil, nil, nil, validationf("validator v1 and deterministic review policy v2 are required")
	}
	checks := map[string]struct{}{}
	if len(blueprint.Evaluation.Validator.Checks) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, nil, validationf("at least one validator check is required")
	}
	evaluatedAcceptance := map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range blueprint.Evaluation.Validator.Checks {
		check := &blueprint.Evaluation.Validator.Checks[index]
		check.ID = strings.TrimSpace(check.ID)
		check.Kind = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(check.Kind))
		check.Visibility = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(check.Visibility))
		if err := addID(checks, check.ID, "validator check"); err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		if _, ok := supportedCheckKinds[check.Kind]; !ok || check.Visibility != "public" && check.Visibility != "private" {
			return nil, nil, nil, validationf("validator check %q is invalid", check.ID)
		}
		var err error
		check.AcceptanceIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(check.AcceptanceIDs, acceptance, "validator acceptance", true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		for _, id := range check.AcceptanceIDs {
			evaluatedAcceptance[id] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	blueprint.Evaluation.Review.AI.Mode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Evaluation.Review.AI.Mode))
	blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Human.Mode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Human.Mode))
	if _, ok := supportedAIReview[blueprint.Evaluation.Review.AI.Mode]; !ok {
		return nil, nil, nil, validationf("unsupported AI review mode")
	}
	if _, ok := supportedHumanReview[blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Human.Mode]; !ok {
		return nil, nil, nil, validationf("unsupported human review mode")
	}
	reviewRules := map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Rules {
		rule := &blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Rules[index]
		rule.ID = strings.TrimSpace(rule.ID)
		if err := addID(reviewRules, rule.ID, "review rule"); err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		var err error
		rule.AcceptanceIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(rule.AcceptanceIDs, acceptance, "review acceptance", true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		for _, id := range rule.AcceptanceIDs {
			evaluatedAcceptance[id] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	for id := range acceptance {
		if _, ok := evaluatedAcceptance[id]; !ok {
			return nil, nil, nil, validationf("acceptance %q has no validator or review rule", id)
		}
	}
	for id := range checks {
		if _, ok := referencedChecks[id]; !ok {
			return nil, nil, nil, validationf("validator check %q is not assigned to a step", id)
		}
	}
	for id := range referencedChecks {
		if _, ok := checks[id]; !ok {
			return nil, nil, nil, validationf("step references unknown validator check %q", id)
		}
	}
	return learning, checks, reviewRules, nil
}

func validateTraceability(links []TraceabilityLink, requirements, acceptance, checks, reviewRules, learning map[string]struct{}) error {
	if len(links) == 0 {
		return validationf("traceability requires at least one link")
	}
	coveredRequirements, coveredLearning := map[string]struct{}{}, map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range links {
		link := &links[index]
		link.RequirementID = strings.TrimSpace(link.RequirementID)
		if _, ok := requirements[link.RequirementID]; !ok {
			return validationf("traceability references unknown requirement %q", link.RequirementID)
		}
		if _, duplicate := coveredRequirements[link.RequirementID]; duplicate {
			return validationf("requirement %q has duplicate traceability", link.RequirementID)
		}
		coveredRequirements[link.RequirementID] = struct{}{}
		var err error
		link.AcceptanceIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(link.AcceptanceIDs, acceptance, "traceability acceptance", true)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		link.ValidatorCheckIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(link.ValidatorCheckIDs, checks, "traceability validator", false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		link.ReviewRuleIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(link.ReviewRuleIDs, reviewRules, "traceability review", false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(link.ValidatorCheckIDs)+len(link.ReviewRuleIDs) == 0 {
			return validationf("requirement %q has no evaluation mapping", link.RequirementID)
		}
		link.LearningRequirementIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(link.LearningRequirementIDs, learning, "traceability learning", true)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, id := range link.LearningRequirementIDs {
			coveredLearning[id] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	for id := range requirements {
		if _, ok := coveredRequirements[id]; !ok {
			return validationf("requirement %q is not traceable", id)
		}
	}
	for id := range learning {
		if _, ok := coveredLearning[id]; !ok {
			return validationf("learning requirement %q is not traceable", id)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateAssistance(policy AssistancePolicy) error {
	if policy.Version != 1 || policy.MaxHintLevel < 0 || policy.MaxHintLevel > 7 || policy.Teacher.MayWriteCompleteSolution {
		return validationf("assistance policy is invalid or reveals a complete solution")
	}
	if policy.RevealSolutionAfterAttempts != nil && *policy.RevealSolutionAfterAttempts < 1 {
		return validationf("solution reveal attempts must be positive")
	}
	return nil
}

func validateFixture(fixture WorkspaceFixture, name string, required bool) error {
	if required && len(fixture.Files) == 0 {
		return validationf("%s requires files", name)
	}
	if len(fixture.Files) > 1000 {
		return validationf("%s exceeds 1000 files", name)
	}
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	total := 0
	for _, file := range fixture.Files {
		if err := validateWorkspacePath(file.Path); err != nil {
			return validationf("%s: %v", name, err)
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[file.Path]; duplicate {
			return validationf("%s duplicates path %q", name, file.Path)
		}
		seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
		if len(file.Content) > 4<<20 {
			return validationf("%s file exceeds 4 MiB", name)
		}
		total += len(file.Content)
		if total > 16<<20 {
			return validationf("%s exceeds 16 MiB", name)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateStarterWorkspace(workspace StarterWorkspace) error {
	if err := validateFixture(workspace.Fixture(), "starter_workspace", true); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	files := make(map[string]WorkspaceFile, len(workspace.Files))
	for _, file := range workspace.Files {
		files[file.Path] = file
	}
	readOnly, err := validateWorkspacePathRefs(workspace.ReadOnlyFiles, files, "starter_workspace.readonly_files")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	editable, err := validateWorkspacePathRefs(workspace.EditableFiles, files, "starter_workspace.editable_files")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for filePath := range readOnly {
		if _, conflict := editable[filePath]; conflict {
			return validationf("starter file %q cannot be read-only and editable", filePath)
		}
	}
	for filePath, file := range files {
		if file.ReadOnly {
			if _, declared := readOnly[filePath]; !declared {
				return validationf("read-only starter file %q is missing from readonly_files", filePath)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(workspace.Entrypoints) == 0 {
		return validationf("starter_workspace requires an entrypoint")
	}
	if _, err := validateWorkspacePathRefs(workspace.Entrypoints, files, "starter_workspace.entrypoints"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if workspace.PreviewConfig == nil || workspace.Meta == nil {
		return validationf("starter_workspace preview_config and meta must be objects")
	}
	return nil
}

func validateWorkspacePathRefs(values []string, files map[string]WorkspaceFile, name string) (map[string]struct{}, error) {
	result := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		if err := validateWorkspacePath(value); err != nil {
			return nil, validationf("%s: %v", name, err)
		}
		if _, exists := files[value]; !exists {
			return nil, validationf("%s references unknown file %q", name, value)
		}
		if _, duplicate := result[value]; duplicate {
			return nil, validationf("%s duplicates %q", name, value)
		}
		result[value] = struct{}{}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validateWorkspacePath(value string) error {
	if value == "" || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\\\x00") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || path.Clean(value) != value || value == "." || value == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(value, "../") {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsafe workspace path %q", value)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateDAG(graph map[string][]string, ids map[string]struct{}, kind string) error {
	state := map[string]uint8{}
	var visit func(string) error
	visit = func(id string) error {
		if state[id] == 1 {
			return validationf("%s dependency cycle at %q", kind, id)
		}
		if state[id] == 2 {
			return nil
		}
		state[id] = 1
		for _, dependency := range graph[id] {
			if _, ok := ids[dependency]; !ok {
				return validationf("%s %q references unknown dependency %q", kind, id, dependency)
			}
			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		state[id] = 2
		return nil
	}
	for id := range graph {
		if err := visit(id); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Digest hashes canonical JSON so embedded raw JSON has the same identity after
// PostgreSQL JSONB persistence and across service boundaries.
func (candidate AuthoringCandidateV1) Digest() (string, error) {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(encoded))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var canonical any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&canonical); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	encoded, err = json.Marshal(canonical)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func BlueprintLearningTargets(blueprint TaskBlueprintV1) []LearningTargetRef {
	seen := map[LearningTargetRef]struct{}{}
	result := []LearningTargetRef{}
	for _, milestone := range blueprint.Milestones {
		for _, step := range milestone.Steps {
			for _, requirement := range step.LearningRequirements {
				if _, ok := seen[requirement.Target]; !ok {
					seen[requirement.Target] = struct{}{}
					result = append(result, requirement.Target)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		if result[i].Type != result[j].Type {
			return result[i].Type < result[j].Type
		}
		if result[i].Key != result[j].Key {
			return result[i].Key < result[j].Key
		}
		return result[i].Version < result[j].Version
	})
	return result
}

func decodeStrict(raw []byte, output any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(output); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return fmt.Errorf("expected one JSON object")
	}
	return nil
}

func validJSONObject(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var value map[string]any
	return len(bytes.TrimSpace(raw)) > 0 && json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) == nil && value != nil
}
func blank(value string) bool { return strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" }
func set(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
	result := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		result[value] = struct{}{}
	}
	return result
}
func validationf(format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrValidation, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}
func addID(target map[string]struct{}, id, kind string) error {
	if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
		return validationf("%s id %q is invalid", kind, id)
	}
	if _, ok := target[id]; ok {
		return validationf("duplicate %s id %q", kind, id)
	}
	target[id] = struct{}{}
	return nil
}
func requireRefs(values []string, known map[string]struct{}, name string) error {
	for _, value := range values {
		if _, ok := known[value]; !ok {
			return validationf("%s references unknown id %q", name, value)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeIdentifierList(values []string, name string, required bool) ([]string, error) {
	if required && len(values) == 0 {
		return nil, validationf("%s requires at least one item", name)
	}
	result := make([]string, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for index, value := range values {
		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
		if !idPattern.MatchString(value) {
			return nil, validationf("%s contains invalid identifier %q", name, value)
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[value]; duplicate {
			return nil, validationf("%s contains duplicate %q", name, value)
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = value
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeText(value, name string) (string, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if value == "" || len(value) > 10000 {
		return "", validationf("%s is required and must not exceed 10000 bytes", name)
	}
	return value, nil
}

func normalizeTextList(values []string, name string, required bool) ([]string, error) {
	if required && len(values) == 0 {
		return nil, validationf("%s requires at least one item", name)
	}
	result := make([]string, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for index, value := range values {
		normalized, err := normalizeText(value, name)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[normalized]; duplicate {
			return nil, validationf("%s contains a duplicate item", name)
		}
		seen[normalized] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = normalized
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeIDList(values []string, name string, required bool) ([]string, error) {
	if required && len(values) == 0 {
		return nil, validationf("%s requires at least one item", name)
	}
	result := make([]string, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for index, value := range values {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if !idPattern.MatchString(value) {
			return nil, validationf("%s contains invalid id %q", name, value)
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[value]; duplicate {
			return nil, validationf("%s contains duplicate id %q", name, value)
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = value
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeReferenceList(values []string, known map[string]struct{}, name string, required bool) ([]string, error) {
	result, err := normalizeIDList(values, name, required)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := requireRefs(result, known, name); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validLearningTargetKey(value string) bool {
	if !targetPattern.MatchString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for _, segment := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
		if segment == "" || segment == "." || segment == ".." {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func normalizeSource(source *SourceProvenance) error {
	source.SourceType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceType))
	source.SourceURL = strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceURL)
	source.SourceCommitSHA = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceCommitSHA))
	source.SourcePath = strings.TrimSpace(source.SourcePath)
	source.SourceLocator = strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceLocator)
	source.OriginalManifestHash = strings.TrimSpace(source.OriginalManifestHash)
	source.Company = strings.TrimSpace(source.Company)
	source.License = strings.TrimSpace(source.License)
	source.EducationalAdaptation = strings.TrimSpace(source.EducationalAdaptation)
	if len(source.SourceType) > 64 || len(source.SourceURL) > 4000 || len(source.SourceCommitSHA) > 64 || len(source.SourcePath) > 1000 || len(source.SourceLocator) > 500 || len(source.Company) > 500 || len(source.License) > 500 || len(source.EducationalAdaptation) > 10000 {
		return validationf("source provenance exceeds limits")
	}
	if source.SourceCommitSHA != "" && !regexp.MustCompile(`^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$`).MatchString(source.SourceCommitSHA) {
		return validationf("source commit must be an exact Git revision")
	}
	if source.SourcePath != "" && (path.IsAbs(source.SourcePath) || strings.Contains(source.SourcePath, "\\") || path.Clean(source.SourcePath) != source.SourcePath || strings.HasPrefix(source.SourcePath, "../")) {
		return validationf("source path is unsafe")
	}
	if source.SourceURL != "" {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(source.SourceURL)
		if err != nil || parsed.Scheme != "https" || parsed.Host == "" || parsed.User != nil {
			return validationf("source URL must be an absolute HTTPS URL")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeGeneration(generation *GenerationMetadata) error {
	generation.PlannerVersion = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.PlannerVersion))
	generation.GenerationPolicyVersion = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.GenerationPolicyVersion))
	generation.Method = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.Method))
	generation.Tone = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.Tone))
	generation.Methodology = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.Methodology))
	generation.PromptTemplateRef = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.PromptTemplateRef))
	generation.ModelProvider = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(generation.ModelProvider))
	generation.ModelID = strings.TrimSpace(generation.ModelID)
	generation.GenerationJobID = strings.TrimSpace(generation.GenerationJobID)
	generation.InputDigest = strings.TrimSpace(generation.InputDigest)
	var err error
	generation.SkillRefs, err = normalizeIdentifierList(generation.SkillRefs, "generation.skill_refs", true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for name, value := range map[string]string{
		"generation.planner_version":           generation.PlannerVersion,
		"generation.generation_policy_version": generation.GenerationPolicyVersion,
		"generation.tone":                      generation.Tone,
		"generation.methodology":               generation.Methodology,
		"generation.model_provider":            generation.ModelProvider,
	} {
		if !idPattern.MatchString(value) {
			return validationf("%s must be a stable identifier", name)
		}
	}
	if generation.Method != "ai" || generation.ModelID == "" || len(generation.ModelID) > 256 || !validUUID(generation.GenerationJobID) {
		return validationf("generation method, model, and job identity are invalid")
	}
	if !promptRefPattern.MatchString(generation.PromptTemplateRef) {
		return validationf("generation prompt template reference is invalid")
	}
	return nil
}

func validUUID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 36 || value[8] != '-' || value[13] != '-' || value[18] != '-' || value[23] != '-' {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.ReplaceAll(value, "-", ""))
	return err == nil
}
